verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded docs say the platform handles multi-state tax requirements and all federal, state, and local filings and payments. They also say companies can have work locations across multiple states with location-based pay schedules, and that employees configure state tax information alongside federal. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-state tax registration/account setup, detail on how per-state withholding is determined (e.g., work vs. resident state), and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-state runs.
